caseNameFull: American Trucking Assns., Inc. v. Gray, Director, Arkansas Highway and Transportation Department

opinions.text: Appeal from Sup. Ct. Ark. Motion of Yellow Freight System et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Judgment vacated and case remanded for further consideration in light of American Trucking Assns., Inc. v. Scheiner, ante, p. 266.
